Stickballman12 LLC Starting a Shipment · Standard Operating Procedure

Start the shipment yourself

The order changed. We used to buy the shipping labels first and build the order around them. Now we want your list before we buy the labels — so you open the shipment, say what you packed, and ask for labels when you’re ready. Nothing you already know how to do goes away; it just happens in a different order.

STEP 1Open a shipment
say how many boxes
STEP 2List each box
what went into it
STEP 3Ask for labels
when it’s all in
STEP 4We send labels
numbers appear on your boxes
STEP 5Print & ship
attach, seal, hand over
What changed, in one line You no longer wait for us before you can start. Pack, list, then ask — and you can print each box’s manifest and seal it while the labels are still coming.
We can still open one for you Nothing about the old way is gone. If we open a shipment for you with the labels already on it, it appears in your list exactly as before and you fill it the same way. Both kinds live in the same list.
1Open the shipment
  1. On Purchase Orders, tap + New shipment.
  2. Say whether it’s shoes or empty shoe boxes — that decides what you’re asked for on every item.
  3. Enter how many boxes you packed. A tag or name is optional but helps us both find it later.
  4. Tap Open shipment.
Boxes can be added or removed afterwards — the number here is just a starting point.
2List what went into each box

Your shipment opens with one card per box. They are numbered Box 1, Box 2 … and stay numbered — that number is how we’ll talk about them until the labels arrive.

  1. Tap Add items on the box you packed first.
  2. Scan or type the SKU, tap the sizes, enter the cost. Exactly as before.
  3. Repeat for each box. + Add a box if you packed more than you said; Remove on a box you didn’t end up using.
Four boxes, no labels yet. Each says so plainly rather than showing a blank tracking number.
Add and remove freely You can change the number of boxes right up until one ships. After that the box is a record of something that physically left, so it stays — tell us and we’ll sort it out.
3Ask for labels

When every box is listed, tap Ask for labels. That is the whole handoff.

The chip changes to Labels requested, and the same words appear on our side.
You can’t ask for labels on an empty shipment If nothing is listed yet, the button refuses — the reason we changed the order of all this is so we see what’s in the boxes before we buy labels for them.
Changed your mind? Cancel the label request puts it back. Adding a box after you’ve asked is fine too — just ask again once it’s listed.

Print the manifest and seal the box — don’t wait for us

This is the part that saves you a day.

You do not have to wait for labels to finish packing. Close a box, print its manifest, tape it inside and seal it. The sheet identifies the box by its number, in large type, and says plainly that the label is still coming:

What the sheet says before the label exists BOX 3 OF 6  ·  NO SHIPPING LABEL YET — identify this box by its NUMBER until the label arrives.
The soft copy updates itself Once we assign the labels, download the manifest again and the same sheet comes out with the tracking number on it. Nothing to re-request and no new link — the file is built fresh every time you download it. Reprint only if you need the paper copy to carry the number too.

What we do at our end

So you know what “Labels requested” sets off.

Your shipment shows in our list chipped Labels requested and From supplier, and it badges our home screen until somebody acts on it.
4We buy the labels and put them on your boxes

We buy a sheet for the number of boxes you declared and drop it into the order. The tracking numbers are read off each page and laid onto your boxes in order — page 1 onto Box 1 — and we check every row before saving.

One row per box you declared. If the courier returns the pages out of order, this screen is where it gets caught.
Why this matters to you The box that ends up with Label 3 is the box you called Box 3. The manifest you already sealed inside it stays correct.
5Print, attach, ship

The tracking numbers appear on your boxes and the cards change from Box to Label. From here it is exactly the flow you already know:

  1. Download all labels (or the one for the box you’re holding) and print it.
  2. Attach the label to the outside.
  3. Ship label once the courier has taken it.
The same box after we assigned the labels — Box 1 is now Label 1, with its number and courier on it.

Old way vs. new way

Both still work. This is only what moved.

We open it (old, still fine)You open it (new)
Who startsStickballman12You
LabelsBought first; already on the orderBought after you ask
You wait for usBefore you can startOnly for the labels
A box is calledLabel 1, from the startBox 1 until it has a label, then Label 1
ManifestHas the tracking number on itBox number first; tracking appears once assigned
Add / remove boxesAsk usYourself, until one ships

If something is not right

What you seeWhat to do
“Add the boxes you packed before asking for labels.”The shipment has no boxes on it. Add one, list what’s in it, then ask.
“Nothing is declared on this order yet.”The boxes exist but are empty. Tap Add items on each one first.
You need one more box after askingAdd it and list it — then ask again so we know to buy another label.
A box shows Remove but you can’t remove itIt has already shipped. Message us; a shipped box is a record of something that left.
The manifest has no tracking numberCorrect — the labels aren’t assigned yet. Seal the box; download the sheet again afterwards for the version with the number.
The label on a box looks like the wrong oneTell us before you ship it. We assign them in box order and can reassign any of them.
